desc: Ideate approaches and select monotonic-stack per-element contribution as the primary method.
Implement monotonic-stack boundary computation for subarray minima and maxima.
Derive and implement an O(1) function to count valid left/right extension pairs with total length at most k.
Accumulate total minimum and maximum contributions using the boundary arrays and bounded pair-counting formula.
Verify duplicate tie-breaking so every subarray minimum and maximum is assigned exactly once.
Test against the provided examples and edge cases such as k=1, k=n, duplicates, negative values, and large intermediate sums.
